findings.title: Raw HTML imports bypass post sanitization
findings.body: Posts imported from RSS are assigned `cook_method: raw_html`, so this branch stores the feed's HTML directly as `cooked` instead of passing it through the normal rendering and sanitization pipeline. Feed content is unescaped before import and is rendered as HTML, so a feed publisher can inject scripts or event handlers that execute on forum pages with the forum's origin and user privileges. Sanitize imported HTML before it is stored or rendered.

findings.title: Remote fetches can follow redirects to internal addresses
findings.body: The embed URL's hostname is checked before this fetch, but `open-uri` follows HTTP redirects without rechecking the destination. An allowed-host URL that redirects to loopback, a private network address, or cloud metadata can therefore make the server fetch internal resources; the response is then passed into the import path. Restrict redirect targets and reject private or otherwise non-public resolved addresses.

findings.title: RSS items with only a description abort feed polling
findings.body: A standard RSS item commonly provides its body in `<description>` rather than `content`; when SimpleRSS has no `content` value, calling `.scrub` on it raises `NoMethodError`. That aborts the poll before later items are processed, and this job has retries disabled. Fall back to the item's description (and handle items with neither field).

findings.title: The iframe height attribute is assigned an invalid value
findings.body: `HTMLIFrameElement.height` reflects an integer-pixel HTML attribute, but this assigns a value such as `500px`. Browsers can treat that as invalid and use the default iframe height instead, leaving the embed clipped even after receiving a resize message. Assign the numeric pixel value or set `iframe.style.height`.

findings.title: The embed URL column truncates valid long URLs
findings.body: A Rails `string` column defaults to `varchar(255)`, while valid embed URLs can exceed 255 characters, especially when they contain query parameters. Saving such an embed raises a database error inside the topic transaction, so the topic import is rolled back. Use a column type and index strategy that support the intended URL lengths.

findings.title: The throttle key can be left without an expiration
findings.body: `SETNX` and `EXPIRE` are separate Redis operations. If the process stops or the second command fails after `SETNX` succeeds, the key remains indefinitely; subsequent non-staff retrieval attempts then treat the URL as recently retrieved and never fetch it. Set the key and TTL atomically, or remove the key when expiration setup fails.
